Hobro Idræts Klub, commonly referred to as Hobro IK or HIK, is a professional football club based in Hobro, Denmark. The club currently competes in the Danish 1st Division, the second tier of the Danish football league system, and plays its home matches at DS Arena, which has served as its primary ground since 1958. Hobro IK is affiliated with the Jutland Football Association.
